title: Enforce tool call scope predicates
summary: Interpret the stable `tool.call.*` scope predicate at dispatch so scoped tool grants can restrict exact call arguments.
expectedFailureModes: Scoped tool grants remain signed metadata even after grant-time validation, so operators cannot narrow high-risk tools by argument.
Argument predicates are interpreted inconsistently across grant and dispatch, causing valid grants to fail or unsafe calls to pass.
Scope rejection is invisible in audit output, making policy failures hard to distinguish from missing actions.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next hardening should enforce stable memory or audit mutation scope predicates.
